verdict.rationale: Stripe documents Payouts (funds sent to bank accounts, dashboard tracking) and provides an MCP server/CLI/API for agents to interact with the Stripe API generally, which supports building an agent-driven reconciliation workflow. However, the evidence pack never mentions the Balance Transactions API specifically or any reconciliation-oriented endpoint/guide tying payouts to underlying charges, so the core mechanic of the story is only inferable, not directly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit Balance Transactions API documentation, guidance on matching payouts to charges/reconciliation workflow, and any hands-on/independent confirmation an agent can perform this via MCP or API.
